delivery_boundaries: This is DEVELOPMENT reuse of 1,294 original and 4,806 additional partial-knowledge proteins. The reference outcomes were previously exposed; no fresh holdout or independent confirmation is claimed.

These are temporal recovery scores against incomplete curator annotations, not whole-graph biological accuracy. Fmax is a benchmark threshold maximum, not percent scientific accuracy or a calibrated acceptance probability.

The published DeepGO-SE sequence/ontology profile uses six checkpoint members per aspect and float32 averaging. Corrected cellular-component model artifacts and native author CLI parity are required by the separate producer.

The source reports 2021 model training, whereas the matched Local profile uses known annotations available in 2023. This compares practical profiles; it does not isolate algorithm, topology, sequence, or ontology-axiom effects.

Actual author training membership and homology separation were not reconstructed. Partial knowledge does not mean proteins were unseen during model training; ESM pretraining overlap is not independently audited.

The inference and CAFA evaluation runtimes are separate and explicitly pinned. Raw scores before the author CLI display cutoff and rounding are evaluated; no score calibration or model retraining is introduced.
All 6,100 dated source sequences are covered. The native first-1,022-residue limit truncates 770 of them; these proteins remain in the fixed evaluation denominators.

The fixed retention rule requires all FOUR paired 95% lower difference bounds against full strict Local to exceed zero: ordinary and information-accretion-weighted BPO in both cohorts. The same native 2,000 shared protein draws are conditional descriptive uncertainty, not independent biological replication.

All 252 outcomes, negative and unsupported controls, all six new aspect/cohort cells, macro and weighted metrics, Smin, and fixed-0.5 trade-offs remain available. No automatic app, graph, pruning, review or model-default change follows.
caveats: Results concern annotation recovery, not scientific accuracy of every Pharos/PPI edge or whole-graph biological precision.

Public retrospective labels and prior newer GOA exposure prevent a wholly developer-blind or prospective-2023 claim; all model inputs exclude future annotation values and recipes/predictions were sealed before each permitted future-reference release.
Shared studies, genes, annotations and graph neighbors limit independence of protein bootstrap intervals.
Intervals are descriptive and are not adjusted across all secondary method/metric/setting comparisons. Positive secondary findings do not replace the failed original primary superiority gate.
The practical Local context gain is mixed across readouts: IA macro can decrease, and fixed0.5 F1/recall decrease while precision increases. Model scores are not calibrated probabilities.
The added-context gain combines more historical topology and annotated neighbors; it does not prove that every added edge is correct or that the pruned edges are false.

The full-versus-old Local contrast also includes global mapping requalification that removes 236 ambiguous old-old source pairs. The frozen FSS decomposition separates source, topology and seed changes for FSS, but no induced-Local arm was declared, so Local's gain is attributed to the profile bundle rather than one isolated cause.
STRING functional-association support is not a universal direct-binding probability; function transfer does not validate direct physical contact.

The old-to-full context comparison restores existing Pharos/STRING source coverage. It improves this application's earlier restricted retrieval; it does not establish a superior graph versus the complete original Pharos source network or newly discovered biological evidence.
Primary and reserved populations are proteins gaining future annotation in this benchmark, not a probability sample of all human proteins or all graph assertions.
Later-publication subsets are substantially smaller after native ontology/known/TOI eligibility; unsupported or pending outcomes are retained explicitly.

Native coverage is the author's prediction-count/eligible-reference ratio. In some later-publication rows, prediction counts retain pre-known-exclusion targets while the eligible denominator shrinks, so this saved ratio can exceed 1. It is preserved, not clamped, and must not be described as a bounded biological coverage fraction.
A no-native-curve outcome is not silently replaced by zero, and missing predictions never remove a reference target.
Historical ontology classes can now be obsolete. Current source inspection retains version/context and does not turn historical model hypotheses into accepted GO annotations.
This new method/source cell was chosen after PK and NK/LK outcomes were exposed; positive outcomes are development evidence only.
The original547 forecast and its benchmark are unchanged. A same-Brev547 replay supplies exact210-target reproducibility; cross-runtime value differences remain recorded.
LocalPlus one-hop neighbor explanations cannot be attached to global GM diffusion scores.
Full source profile includes topology, known training seeds and identifier qualification; four-cell differences are not a pure topology causal effect.
